mapper.select: SELECT id, title, memo, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun FROM reminders
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminders (title, memo, mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun, notify_hour, notify_minute) VALUES (#{title}, #{memo}, #{mon}, #{tue}, #{wed}, #{thu}, #{fri}, #{sat}, #{sun}, #{notifyHour}, #{notifyMinute})
mapper.update: UPDATE reminders SET title = #{title}, memo = #{memo}, mon = #{mon}, tue = #{tue}, wed = #{wed}, thu = #{thu}, fri = #{fri}, sat = #{sat}, sun = #{sun} WHERE id = #{id}
